title: Generative Modeling with Optimal Transport Maps
tldr_zh: 普通 CNN 在 ambient 图像空间解 W2 min-max 学 OT map 当生成器（OTM），支持不等维嵌入 cost，duality-gap 界 FID
tldr_en: OTM learns the W2 optimal transport map directly in ambient image space with plain CNNs via min-max, handles unequal dimensions, and bounds FID by duality gaps.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10: IS 7.42, FID 21.78 vs AE-OT-GAN 17.1, 3P-WGAN 28.8, WGAN-GP 39.40 (Table 1)
CelebA64 FID 6.5 vs AE-OT-GAN 7.8, WGAN-QC 12.9, NCP-VAE 5.2 (Table 2); MNIST FID 2.4 (Table 6)
Unpaired restoration CelebA64 FID denoising/colorization/inpainting: OTM 5.92/5.65/8.13 vs WGAN-GP 25.49/7.75/16.51 (Table 3)
W2 benchmark Early image pair L2-UVP 1.32% vs MM:R 1.4% (Table 4)
Gradient optimality lambda ablation on CelebA FID: 16.91/16.22/16.70/10.01/6.50 for lambda 0.001..10 (Table 5)
